Business Overview:
[1]
Glass Walls Systems (India) Limited is a
premium façade solutions and fenestration company operating across India, the USA,
and Australia. The company is among the
largest façade solution providers in India
and has built its business around designing, engineering, manufacturing, supplying, and,
in the domestic market, installing specialised building façade systems. As of March 31st, 2026, the company had completed over 158 projects.
